declarations.description:
A numbered marker in generated text that names its source, like the inline citations of Perplexity and ChatGPT
search. The marker is a link to `href`; hovering or focusing it opens a preview card with the site, the page's title,
a snippet and the address, which the pointer can move into and which Escape closes.

The marker shows `index` (or the default slot's content, such as a site name), and a screen reader hears it as
"Source 1: <title>" in the page's language. Only http(s) and relative addresses become links: a `javascript:` or
other address in model output is dropped, and the marker then only opens its preview. The `preview` slot replaces the
card's content.

The preview is a `c2-hover-card`, so it opens after `open-delay` and never on touch, where a tap follows the link.
Put everything the card says somewhere a touch or keyboard-only reader can also reach it, such as a list of sources.

declarations.description:
The "Used 12 sources" line under an AI answer, like the sources of Perplexity and ChatGPT search: a stack of the
sites' icons and a count, which expands into a card per source. It collects the `c2-citation` markers of the answer
it sits in (its parent element, or the element named by `for`), one card per address however often it is cited, in
the order of their numbers, and follows the answer as markers are added, as they are while it streams. Pointing at a
card highlights the markers that cite it.

The sources can also be handed over as `sources` (a JSON attribute or the property), which then wins over the
markers. Only http(s) and relative addresses become links, and only those (plus `data:image/`) load as icons.

The cards sit in a native `<details>`, so the summary is a keyboard-reachable toggle and the browser's find-in-page
opens the list when it finds a source in it.

members.name: for
members.description:
The `id` of the element whose `c2-citation` markers are listed, in the same document or shadow root. Without it,
the markers of the list's parent element (past any wrapper that holds nothing but the list, such as a framework's
island element). Markers inside another component's shadow root are not found: hand those
sources over as `sources`.

members.name: sources
members.description:
The sources, handed over as a JSON attribute or the property (`[{ index, href, title, snippet, site, favicon }]`).
When it holds any, it wins over the markers, which are then only highlighted from the cards.

members.name: open
members.description: Whether the cards are shown. Follows the toggle; set it to open or close the list.

members.name: maxIcons
members.description: How many site icons the toggle stacks, one per site.

members.name: target
members.description: Where a card's link opens. A source leaves the page the reader is on, so a new tab by default.

members.name: renderSource
members.description: Draws the content of each card (its number, site, title and snippet by default).

members.name: collected
members.description: The sources the markers name, gathered on connection and on every change to them.

members.name: watch
members.description: Starts following the markers, with the collector loaded the first time.

members.name: renderIcons
members.description: One icon per site, the first `maxIcons` sites: the site's first favicon, else its first letter.

events.description: Re-dispatched from the native details after the list opens or closes (`newState` is `open` or `closed`).
events.name: toggle
